title: BreakGlassActionReportedPayload
description: Payload of the BreakGlassActionReported platform event (class: platform; INV-REQ-897, INV-Q-9117 option A, INV-Q-9313 option A). tenancy-svc reports an action it carried out under an open break-glass session; access-svc records it once per reportId with the same ACC-002 alert and audit entry as a synchronous action. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

reportId.description: Idempotency key of this report, unique per reported action; a second delivery of the same reportId is recorded once.

unlockRef.description: The break-glass unlock (session) the action ran under.

action.description: The break-glass action carried out. Extensible enum (API-41): the consumer drops a member it does not know.

target.description: The method and path template the action was applied to, when it has a target (at most the 128 characters of BreakGlassActionRequest.target).
